notes: Dev TBox contraction, paired with mathematics-replace-d005: removes the rule 'The area of every circle is πr²' (has_formula). The direct, paraphrase, cross-lingual and propositional questions become 'does not know' (strong Kleene for the propositional ones). The three derived questions are the revision's: a new circular object named in the prompt with its radius (inheritance, 2 hops, membership in the prompt), asking its area, a threshold comparison and a ratio to a unit square. An ideal contraction gives up the supporting knowledge too (integration, half the circumference times the radius), so the derived questions expect 'I don't know' even though the area could be rebuilt. Unrelated near is the area of a square (s²); the circumference formula was avoided because it hands the model the route back. The side fact 'Every circle has four corners' is backed by the definition of a circle and a count of the denying wording.
